messages:
pagerduty-bot: SEV2 ALERT — GPU_POOL_SATURATION (eu-west-1) service=redwood-serving autoscaler=scale-controller link=https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-8243 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Symptoms: queue_length>15000, token_p95_latency>1200ms, error_rate(429)=18%

alex_cheng: oncall here, pulling graphs now.

alex_cheng: Confirming queue spike — ingesters showing sustained enqueue at ~600rps for last 8m. backlog growth from 1.9k -> 16.2k.

lili_ops: autoscaler logs show repeated errors: `ScaleUp failed: quota_exceeded` and `provider_rate_limit` around same time. looks like attempted scale from 40 -> 120 but cloud denied.

samir_k: copying relevant snippets:
```
2026-03-15T03:12:09Z scale-controller INFO: desired=120 current=40
2026-03-15T03:12:10Z cloud-api ERROR: CreateInstances failed code=QuotaExceeded message=GPU quota for eu-west-1 reached
2026-03-15T03:12:11Z scale-controller WARN: backoff=30s reason=quota_exceeded
```

maria_prod: customer-facing metrics: active requests saw 30% of hosts returning 429s, streaming failures for mid-size inference jobs. support already triaging high-usage customers.

infra-oncall: provider console shows regional quota at limit and the global account has pending quota request (submitted earlier today) but not approved yet. we can request emergency increase but might take ~1h.

alex_cheng: immediate mitigation options: 1) evict low-priority jobs and free GPU slots, 2) divert traffic to us-west-2 pool, 3) enable aggressive prefix caching/kv cache to reduce per-request tokens, 4) enable model fallbacks (smaller model) for non-SLAs.

lili_ops: I'm running eviction script for low-priority batch jobs now (`./scripts/evict-low-pri.sh --pool eu-west-1`). will post progress.

samir_k: I'll open a manual scaling attempt with infra team to add preemptible GPUs in eu-west-1 as a stopgap: `infra-cli pool add --region eu-west-1 --type p-t4 --count 40 --labels emergency`

maria_prod: support: prepare status page blurb. customers affected: 12 accounts with heavy embedding workloads. please capture affected org IDs so we can correlate.

support_lead: Got org IDs from logs, pinging account owners, drafting message.

infra-oncall: manual scale request submitted to cloud, but cloud API returns `400: region_capacity_insufficient` for preemptibles. trying another instance type (p-v4) now.

lili_ops: eviction completed — cleared ~25% of backlog (evicted 2200 low-pri jobs). queue down to ~12k. latency improved slightly.

alex_cheng: thanks. Maria — can we flip routing for non-enterprise traffic to us-west-2? we need to limit blast radius.

maria_prod: starting controlled routing change: `redwoodctl route update --match "plan:free|plan:standard" --dest us-west-2 --weight 0.7` Do not route enterprise customers.

pagerduty-bot: ACTION: incident acknowledged by alex_cheng. responders: lili_ops (ops), samir_k (infra), maria_prod (product/support)

samir_k: manual fallback: created a temporary eu-west-1 pool using spare infra in a partner account with 24 GPUs. added routing rule to include this pool for non-SLA traffic. verifying connectivity to runtime.

alex_cheng: good. we're seeing queue trend flattening. p95 token latency -> 800ms, 429s down to 6%. still not fully recovered.

lili_ops: autoscaler still can't scale because the account-level quota is preventing scale decisions. adding better observability item: autoscaler should surface quota errors to ops dashboard more prominently.

infra-oncall: update from cloud support: emergency quota increase request accepted but ETA 45-75 minutes.

maria_prod: support message posted to customers affected. include note: engineering working on mitigation, some requests may see longer latency or be routed to another region.

support_lead: tracking customer replies; a handful asked for SLA credits — collecting evidence for impact.

alex_cheng: short-term wrap: backlog partially reduced via eviction + emergency partner pool + routing. plan for next 2 hours: monitor until queue <2k and 429s <1%.

samir_k: long-term actions proposed during live triage: 1) raise provider GPU quotas for eu regions (submit proactive requests), 2) autoscaler: detect repeated quota_exceeded and apply tiered fallback (spill to partner pools / region routing), 3) emergency runbook for manual preemptible pool creation, 4) prioritize eviction heuristics for cost/latency tradeoffs.

lili_ops: logging a quick post-incident note here so we capture initial action items. will create GH issues.

alex_cheng: Postmortem owner: alex_cheng. Timeline + logs saved under incident artifact: `s3://redwood-incidents/3332109876/`

maria_prod: post-incident comms: customer-ready summary + timeline + mitigation steps. I can draft once we have final numbers.

support_lead: open action item: collect list of impacted orgs + token usage during event. assigned to support_lead, due EOD.

samir_k: infra action item: add alerting that flips autoscaler to read-only if it receives >3 quota_exceeded errors in 5m and trigger partner-pool strategy. assigned to samir_k.

lili_ops: ops action item: improve eviction tool to mark jobs for retry window and not drop; also add better visibility into queue composition. assigned to lili_ops.

alex_cheng: followups consolidated:
- Owner: alex_cheng — postmortem + RCA, include decision tree for manual scale vs route (due in 3 days)
- Owner: samir_k — autoscaler quota-handling changes + partner pool orchestration (due in 2 weeks)
- Owner: lili_ops — eviction/improved queue tooling (due in 1 week)
- Owner: infra-oncall — submit proactive quota increase for eu-west-1 & eu-central-1 (in flight)
- Owner: maria_prod & support_lead — customer comms and SLA remediation plan (due 48h)

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (status: mitigated) — queue trending to normal, core API error rate back to baseline.

maria_prod: thanks everyone. I'll circulate a short customer note and postmortem link when alex posts the doc. :thumbsup:

alex_cheng: ended triage. saving notes and closing this thread.
